GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 2nd 2 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 3rd Kept Going Ok final 200m # on pace/honest run
Jumped Well Settled Down Outside Leader 1 Lengths 800m 3rd 3 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 1st Middle Of Track hit lead 300m picked up final 50m # on pace/good effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race. Near the 1100m was awkwardly placed near heels. Thereafter raced keenly when being restrained to obtain cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled 3rd behind Fast Pace Leader 5 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden soon after Straightening Up and weakened last 200m # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the 500m began to over-race with its head up and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped. Near the 200m laid in and away from another runner and was awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 4th 3 Wide 3 Lengths 800m 4th 5 Lengths home turn Hooked Out Four Wide 3rd hit front 150m Kept Going Too Well # good ride/win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and contacted another rnr. Laid in under pressure approaching the 200m before having to be corrected by its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Crowded early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed out Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & gave ground in last 200m. # Wide/never likely.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start became crowded between rnrs. Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well enough, Went Forward Settled Down Two Wide 2nd, 1 length @ 600m. Hard Ridden Straightening Up as Leader kicked. this all Clear Just Held Ground , lost 3rd place last two bounds. $5.50 Winner Led All The Way # sat 2nd/winner led
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. looking for run turn. held up early in Straight . got split 300 metres. ran on well # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1/2L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & outgunned in last 200m. # On-pace/no match
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced 6th on inside (2.5L from lead). Raced keenly & improved to track leaders on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & worked home steadily without threatening in last 200m. # Sound effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled 4-5l off, gave ground turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m was shifted out after being hampered.
